finding.headline: "Homework While the Baby Cries"
finding.problem: "My daughter needs me for maths but the baby is screaming at 6pm. I snap at her, then cry. She's falling behind and it's my fault."
finding.person: Mum of a 7-year-old whose homework now happens during newborn feeds; evenings are a pressure cooker (Motherly, 2026).
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (homework-sprint system) — strong diaspora (UK/US school system)". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
